obligations.target: Verify parameter input fields are generated alongside interactive API call definitions on the main page
obligations.reason: Vitest is the configured test runner in this repository; unit tests verify that the HTML view rendering logic presents input fields for parameterised endpoints.

obligations.target: Verify API call execution using a user-supplied parameter value and rendering of the resulting output
obligations.reason: Unit testing validates endpoint resolution, parameter insertion, and response rendering for a single parameterised API call.

obligations.target: Verify API call execution incorporating multiple supplied parameter values and display of the returned data
obligations.reason: Unit tests ensure all provided parameter fields are correctly substituted into the target API call and combined results are presented.

obligations.target: Verify validation prevents execution and displays an indication when a required parameter is missing
obligations.reason: Unit tests verify input validation logic that halts request triggering and provides user feedback when required parameter values are blank.

obligations.target: Verify API re-execution with updated parameter values and rendering of the updated response
obligations.reason: Unit tests ensure changing parameter inputs and re-running executes the request with the new values and refreshes the displayed response.

obligations.target: Verify parameter handling, encoding, and response display when parameter values contain special characters or spaces
obligations.reason: Unit testing verifies that special characters and spaces are safely handled and encoded during API request triggering and output rendering.
